In his last illness the Prophet had Abu Bakr lead the prayer despite Aisha's objections, once prayed seated beside him, and on Monday looked at the rows and died.
When his illness worsened on a Thursday, the Prophet asked to write a guiding document; they disputed, Umar saying the Quran suffices, and the Prophet willed polytheists out of Arabia.
In his last illness the Prophet awaited Aisha's turn and died against her chest, asking pardon and mercy and choosing the highest companions, as every prophet is given a choice.
